<!--
Element: Auto-advancing feature tabs
ID: 213 · Category: Sections & Content · Tags: tabs, autoplay, features, progress, landing
What it does: A landing page's feature tabs move to the next tab every few seconds, and the bar under the current tab fills with the time left. When the tab changes, the product screen below swaps and plays its scene: calendar blocks drop into place, document lines write themselves, or chart bars grow. Press a tab to jump straight to it, and rest the pointer on the screen to pause the bar.
How to use it: Press a tab, or rest the pointer on the screen to pause the auto-advance
Footprint: fixed size, square
Needs: tokens.css (the --ux-* theme tokens and the .ux base). Map the tokens to the project's theme variables.
Live demo: https://lucianlabs.dev/uxui-prompt/#213
-->
<style>
.u213{position:relative;width:340px;height:340px;border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(80% 50% at 50% 0%,var(--ux-accent-soft),transparent 70%),var(--ux-surface);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ux-line),0 30px 60px -36px var(--ux-shadow-strong);color:var(--ux-ink)}
.u213-hd{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:20px;text-align:center}
.u213-hd small{font-size:10px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ux-accent)}
.u213-hd h3{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:19px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.u213-tl{position:absolute;left:18px;right:18px;top:76px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px}
.u213-tb{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:7px 4px 10px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:none;color:var(--ux-ink-3);font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:color .25s,background .25s}

.u213-pn{position:absolute;inset:0;padding:12px 14px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px) scale(.98);transition:opacity .35s,transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);pointer-events:none}
.u213-pn.is-on{opacity:1;transform:none}
.u213-pn small{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ux-ink-3)}

.u213-wk{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:4px;margin-top:6px;height:132px}
.u213-wk>span{display:block;border-radius:7px;background:var(--ux-surface-2);font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ux-ink-3);text-align:center;padding-top:4px}
.u213-ev{position:absolute;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 4px;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;color:#fff;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px) scale(.9);transition:opacity .3s,transform .45s cubic-bezier(.3,1.5,.5,1);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.u213-pn.is-play .u213-ev{opacity:1;transform:none}

.u213-dh{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.u213-dh b{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:900;margin-right:auto}
.u213-dh em{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-style:normal;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;color:#DB2777}
.u213-dh em::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
.u213-ln{height:7px;margin-top:9px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--ux-surface-3);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:0 50%;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.3,1)}
.u213-ln.is-h{height:10px;background:var(--ux-ink-3);margin-top:14px}
.u213-pn.is-play .u213-ln{transform:scaleX(var(--w))}
.u213-cr{position:absolute;width:2px;height:12px;background:#DB2777;border-radius:1px;left:14px;top:40px;opacity:0;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.3,.8,.3,1),opacity .2s}
.u213-cr::after{content:"Jimin";position:absolute;left:0;top:-13px;padding:1px 4px;border-radius:4px 4px 4px 0;background:#DB2777;color:#fff;font-size:8px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.u213-pn.is-play .u213-cr{opacity:1}

.u213-kp{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;margin-top:2px}

.u213-kp span{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#059669}
.u213-br{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:7px;height:96px;margin-top:8px;padding-bottom:1px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ux-line)}
.u213-br i{flex:1;border-radius:5px 5px 2px 2px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ux-accent) 30%,transparent);height:var(--h);transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:50% 100%;transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.3,1.3,.5,1)}
.u213-br i:last-child{background:var(--ux-accent)}
.u213-pn.is-play .u213-br i{transform:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.u213-pn,.u213-ev,.u213-ln,.u213-br i,.u213-cr{transition:none!important}}

<div class="ux u213">
  <div class="u213-hd"><small>Features</small><h3>Your team's work, one screen</h3></div>
  <div class="u213-tl" role="tablist" aria-label="Feature tabs">
    <button type="button" class="u213-tb" role="tab"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="2" y="3" width="12" height="11" rx="2.2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M2 6.5h12M5.5 1.5v3M10.5 1.5v3" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>Schedule<i><b></b></i></button>
    <button type="button" class="u213-tb" role="tab"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 1.8h5.5L13 5.3v8.4a.6.6 0 0 1-.6.6H4a.6.6 0 0 1-.6-.6V2.4a.6.6 0 0 1 .6-.6z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M6 8.5h4.5M6 11h3" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>Docs<i><b></b></i></button>
    <button type="button" class="u213-tb" role="tab"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.5 13.5h11M4.5 11V8M8 11V4.5M11.5 11V6.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>Reports<i><b></b></i></button>
  </div>
  <div class="u213-pv">
    <div class="u213-pn" role="tabpanel"><small>Oct, week 3</small><div class="u213-wk"><span>Mon</span><span>Tue</span><span>Wed</span><span>Thu</span><span>Fri</span></div></div>
    <div class="u213-pn" role="tabpanel"><div class="u213-dh"><b>Launch prep notes</b><em>editing</em></div><div class="u213-ln is-h" style="--w:.55"></div><div class="u213-ln" style="--w:.95"></div><div class="u213-ln" style="--w:.82"></div><div class="u213-ln" style="--w:.9"></div><div class="u213-ln is-h" style="--w:.4"></div><div class="u213-ln" style="--w:.75"></div><div class="u213-ln" style="--w:.6"></div><span class="u213-cr" aria-hidden="true"></span></div>
    <div class="u213-pn" role="tabpanel"><small>Revenue this month</small><div class="u213-kp"><b>₩0</b><span>+18% vs last month</span></div><div class="u213-br"><i style="--h:38%"></i><i style="--h:52%"></i><i style="--h:44%"></i><i style="--h:63%"></i><i style="--h:58%"></i><i style="--h:76%"></i><i style="--h:94%"></i></div></div>
  </div>

<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;
  var T = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.u213-tb')), P = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.u213-pn')), pv = root.querySelector('.u213-pv');
  var rm = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var uid = 'u213' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
  T.forEach(function (t, i) { t.id = uid + 't' + i; P[i].id = uid + 'p' + i; t.setAttribute('aria-controls', P[i].id); P[i].setAttribute('aria-labelledby', t.id); });
  var EV = [[0, 8, 22, 'Planning'], [1, 30, 20, 'Design review'], [2, 6, 16, '1:1'], [2, 52, 24, 'Launch check'], [3, 18, 30, 'Interviews'], [4, 40, 18, 'Retro']];
  var EC = ['#6366F1', '#EC4899', '#0EA5E9', '#F59E0B', '#10B981', '#8B5CF6'], wk = root.querySelector('.u213-wk');
  EV.forEach(function (e, i) { var d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'u213-ev'; d.textContent = e[3]; d.style.cssText = 'left:calc(' + e[0] * 20 + '% + 1px);width:calc(20% - 6px);top:calc(18px + ' + e[1] + '% * .8);height:calc(' + e[2] + '% * .8);background:' + EC[i] + ';transition-delay:' + (0.15 + i * 0.09) + 's'; wk.appendChild(d); });
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(root.querySelectorAll('.u213-ln'), function (l, i) { l.style.transitionDelay = (0.1 + i * 0.12) + 's'; });
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(root.querySelectorAll('.u213-br i'), function (b, i) { b.style.transitionDelay = (0.08 + i * 0.06) + 's'; });
  var cr = root.querySelector('.u213-cr'), kp = root.querySelector('.u213-kp b');
  var DUR = 4200, cur = -1, acc = 0, last = 0, hold = false, vis = true, raf = 0, sub = [];
  function clearSub() { sub.forEach(clearTimeout); sub = []; }
  function scene(i) {
    var p = P[i]; p.classList.remove('is-play'); void p.offsetWidth; p.classList.add('is-play'); clearSub();
    if (i === 1) {
      var L = p.querySelectorAll('.u213-ln');
      cr.style.transform = 'translate(0,0)';
      [1, 2, 3, 5].forEach(function (n, k) { sub.push(setTimeout(function () { var l = L[n]; cr.style.transform = 'translate(' + (l.offsetWidth * parseFloat(l.style.getPropertyValue('--w'))).toFixed(0) + 'px,' + (l.offsetTop - 40 - 3) + 'px)'; }, rm ? 0 : 250 + k * 380)); });
    }
    if (i === 2) {
      var to = 48200000, t0 = performance.now();
      if (rm) { kp.textContent = '₩' + to.toLocaleString('ko-KR'); return; }
      (function f(now) { var k = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / 1100), e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3); kp.textContent = '₩' + (Math.round(to * e / 10000) * 10000).toLocaleString('ko-KR'); if (k < 1 && cur === 2) requestAnimationFrame(f); })(t0);
    }
  }
  function go(i) {
    if (i === cur) return;
    cur = i; acc = 0;
    T.forEach(function (t, k) { var on = k === i; t.classList.toggle('is-on', on); t.setAttribute('aria-selected', on); t.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1; t.querySelector('b').style.transform = 'scaleX(' + (on && rm ? 1 : 0) + ')'; });
    P.forEach(function (p, k) { p.classList.toggle('is-on', k === i); p.setAttribute('aria-hidden', k !== i); if (k !== i) p.classList.remove('is-play'); });
    scene(i);
  }
  function tick(now) {
    raf = 0;
    if (!root.isConnected || rm) return;
    if (!hold && vis) acc += Math.min(64, now - last);
    last = now;
    var p = Math.min(1, acc / DUR);
    T[cur].querySelector('b').style.transform = 'scaleX(' + p.toFixed(3) + ')';
    if (p >= 1) go((cur + 1) % T.length);
    if (vis) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function run() { if (!raf && !rm) { last = performance.now(); raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick); } }
  T.forEach(function (t, i) {
    t.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i); run(); });
    t.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      var d = e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : e.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? -1 : 0;
      if (d) { e.preventDefault(); var n = (i + d + T.length) % T.length; go(n); T[n].focus(); }
    });
  });
  pv.addEventListener('pointerenter', function () { hold = true; });
  pv.addEventListener('pointerleave', function () { hold = false; });
  root.addEventListener('focusin', function () { hold = true; });
  root.addEventListener('focusout', function () { hold = false; });
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) new IntersectionObserver(function (es) { vis = es[0].isIntersecting; if (vis) run(); }).observe(root);
  go(0); run();
})();
</script>
